datasheet: TI TPS61022 SLVSDX7D (Jul 2021) [.review/openaio-whoop-review/datasheets/TPS61022RWUR.pdf, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps61022.pdf; pin map, outline and p26/p27 numbers re-read 2026-10-11]: p3 Figure 5-1 (top view: GND/SW/VOUT left top-down, VIN/MODE/EN/FB right top-down) + Table 5-1 pins 1-7; p25 RWU0007A package outline 4223724/C (body 1.9-2.1 square, pins 1/3 0.3-0.4 wide 0.85-1.05 long, pin 2 0.15-0.25 wide 1.15-1.35 long, pins 4-7 0.2-0.3 x 0.2-0.3 at 0.5 pitch); p26 example board layout (pins 1/3 2X (1.15) x 2X (0.35) at (0.55) from the centre line, centre (0.625) left of PKG CL; pin 2 (1.45) x (0.2), centre (0.475) left of PKG CL; pins 4-7 4X (0.45) x 4X (0.25) at (0.975) right of PKG CL, 3X (0.5) pitch, (1.5) span); p27 stencil (pins 1/3: 2 apertures 4X (0.475) x (0.35) at (0.675) pitch, (0.288) from PKG CL; pin 2: 2 apertures 2X (0.625) x (0.2), right edge flush; 83 % coverage; pins 4-7 1:1)
derivation: IPC-7351 least density (L) variant of lib:TI_VQFN-HR-7_2x2mm_RWU (D109, D101 full land set): toe 1.08 on all 7 lands (RWU0007A body 1.9-2.1 -> 1.05 max + 0.03), heels/widths kept (power pads), outer paste windows of pins 1-3 clipped to the copper (pin 1/3 81 %, pin 2 85 %). Rule: outer land edge = max(terminal end nominal + 0.05, terminal end at max package tolerance + 0.03), capped at nominal + 0.15; heel kept unless it ran past D/2 - Lmax; side = max(IPC-7351B L X, b nominal), never wider than the original; courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10. Origin, pad numbers, EP/paste/mask and 3D model unchanged. Base derivation: Pad edges from p26: left lands x -1.20..-0.05 (pins 1/3) and -1.20..+0.25 (pin 2), right lands +0.75..+1.20; pins 1-3 are power pads with split paste per p27 (exposed 1-3 here so the 2-window paste is checked: pin 1/3 82.6 %, pin 2 86.2 %). Origin = package centre.
